packages.title: Young India: Full Body Checkup
packages.description: Young India: Full Body Checkup package is designed to screen various chronic diseases and also helps in asessment overall health of a person
packages.recommended_for: Healthy individuals who wans to screen their health for basic parametes for early detection of any health issues
packages.what_test: Young India: Full Body Checkup package is designed to screen various chronic diseases and also helps in asessment overall health of a person
packages.why_test: Recommended For: Healthy individuals who wans to screen their health for basic parametes for early detection of any health issues
packages.how_test: You can get Young India: Full Body Checkup done from any of the Hindustan Wellness laboratories. Book your appointment through the website by selecting the test. You need to provide your phone number for furthering the procedure. Besides, you can choose to either prepay or postpay for the test.
preparation_instructions: Please do not consume your morning dose of tablets (if any) prior to Sample Collection.
Please do not consume alcohol/nicotine 24 hours prior to health check.

Specifically for ladies: If you are menstruating on the scheduled day of your health checkup, kindly inform us. Since you will not be able to do your urine tests as the presence of blood would produce inaccurate results.

faqs.answer: Ans. Down syndrome is a genetic disorder which is caused when there is abnormal cell division. Generally, a baby is born with 46 chromosomes but, in the case of down syndrome, one extra copy of one of these chromosomes is developed in the baby. Symptoms of down syndrome are, delay in the development of the baby and learning disabilities. Some symptoms are evident such as not having a normal face structure and a speaking disability. Children suffering from down syndrome need extra care and special supervision.

faqs.answer: Ans. Neural tube defects are developed at a very early stage of pregnancy. Sometimes even before the mother got to know about the pregnancy. Neural tube defects can occur when the neural tube of the baby does not close properly. There are two common neural tube defects, one is Spina bifida and another one is anencephaly.

faqs.question: elevated alpha-fetoprotein in humans is a life-threatening condition.

This may result in stillborn children sometimes if not curable. Twin children may also result in elevated alpha-fetoprotein.

faqs.question: What is the Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme test?
faqs.answer: An enzyme that changes angiotensin I into angiotensin II is called the angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE). Angiotensin II causes the body's tiny blood vessels to constrict or narrow, which aids in raising blood pressure.

faqs.question: How long does it take to get the report of the Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE) test?
faqs.answer: You can receive the reports at Hindustan Wellness within twenty-four hours of the sample collection.

faqs.question: Can I get the Angiotensin-Converting Enzyme (ACE) test done after consuming food?
faqs.answer: Contrary to other blood tests, the ACE test doesn't need any particular setup. There is no need to abstain from any meals or medications, nor is there any obligation to fast for a set period of time. However, if the patient is taking blood thinners, the doctor or the technician doing the blood test must be informed so that appropriate safety measures can be taken.

faqs.question: What happens when the ACE level is low?
faqs.answer: Low ACE levels could be a sign of chronic liver disease and an eating disorder named anorexia nervosa.

faqs.question: What do high ACE levels signify?
faqs.answer: Sarcoidosis may be indicated by an ACE level that is higher than usual. As sarcoidosis becomes worse or gets better, ACE levels may increase or decrease. Additional illnesses and disorders that might cause an elevated ACE level include Addison disease.

faqs.question: What happens in Addison's disease?
faqs.answer: Adrenal insufficiency, commonly known as Addison's disease, is a rare ailment that develops when the human body doesn't generate enough specific hormones. Your adrenal glands, which are right above your kidneys, generate insufficient cortisol and frequently too little aldosterone when you have Addison's disease.

faqs.question: What are atopic allergies?
faqs.answer: Atopic allergy is a condition that makes your skin red and itchy. It is a common condition but can occur to a person of any age. It is a chronic and long-lasting disease that can come back periodically even after treatment.

faqs.question: What are measures one can take to prevent atopic allergies?
faqs.answer:
During atopy, our body responds to foreign substances by producing a higher amount of antigen, which is known as immunoglobulin E (IgE). This also leads to the production of histamine and some other chemicals responsible for causing inflammation. There is no permanent cure for atopic allergies. But here are a few measures that you can take to prevent them. 
Apply moisturiser on your skin at least twice a day
Try to identify the situations that worsen your condition
Take short showers or baths
Take a bleach bath
Use only gentle soaps
Completely dry yourself

packages.description: A positive result indicates that the patient is allergic to one or more of these allergens; a negative indicates the patient is not allergic to inhalant allergens
packages.what_test:
Immunoglobulin E (IgE) levels in your blood are determined by an allergy blood test. IgE is an antibody that your body makes. IgE levels in the blood may be higher than usual if you have allergies.

Your immune system is impacted by allergies, a common chronic condition. In order to defend against viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens, your immune system produces antibodies. When your immune system interprets one or more benign substances, like pollen or peanuts, as a danger, allergies develop. IgE antibodies are created by your immune system to defend against the "threat." This threat is the reason for your allergy symptoms. 

Depending on the allergy you have, you may experience different symptoms. They may include sneezing and itching as well as asthma or the potentially fatal anaphylactic shock. The allergy screening aids in the diagnosis of allergic diseases. Additionally, it is occasionally used to check for parasitic infections. The Total IgE and Phadiatop tests are part of the allergy screening. When someone shows symptoms like itchiness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, itchy eyes, sneezing, eczema, coughing, etc., this screening is advised. 

The Allergy screening IgE-total antibodies with the Phadiatop test is available at Hindustan Wellness for a price that is significantly less than the going rate in the market. Our skilled healthcare practitioners carry out each test perfectly. Moreover, the technicians have extensive experience performing complex tests.
packages.why_test:
To determine if someone has an allergy, allergy screening tests are used. The following are some of the reasons why this test is required:
Immunoglobulin E (IgE) is an antibody that protects the body from parasitic infestation. 
They also help with early recognition of foreign material and general immune system potentiation through improved antigen presentation.
This IgE allergy test determines the amount of IgE antibodies in the blood. These antibodies are found in trace amounts. The presence of these antibodies rises when the body overreacts to allergens.
This test aids in the diagnosis of allergic disease, primary immunodeficiency, infections, malignancies, and other inflammatory diseases.
If you are unable to have allergy skin testing, your healthcare provider may order an allergy screen test. Skin testing entails putting allergens on or into your skin.
This test is particularly effective at detecting allergies associated with lung disease.

DIC (Disseminated intravascular coagulation) is a health condition where the proteins responsible for clotting the blood become hyperactive causing unnecessary clotting of blood inside the body and uncontrollable bleeding as well. Such a condition is normally seen when a certain body part is injured. 

Multiple clottings can cause blockage in the path of blood flow to the heart, kidney and liver, instigating serious health issues. The test is conducted to understand the cause and effect of the DIC condition.

packages.title: Alkaline Phosphatase, Serum
packages.description: Alkaline phosphatase testing measures the amount of this enzyme in the blood.Alkaline phosphatase (ALP) is an enzyme that is present in many parts of the body
packages.what_test:
Alkaline phosphatase (ALP) is a blood enzyme that aids in the breakdown of proteins. The Alkaline Phosphatase, Serum test determines the amount of alkaline phosphatase (ALP) in your blood. This enzyme is found all over the body, but it is most commonly found in the liver, bones, kidneys, and digestive system. ALP's function is unknown to researchers. However, they believe it is critical for a variety of processes. Because it is primarily found in the liver, ALP is frequently referred to as a liver enzyme. 

Elevated ALP levels may be a sign of liver disease. There are many symptoms your body exhibits when you have liver disease, such as jaundice, which causes your skin and the whites of your eyes to turn yellow. You may experience abdominal discomfort or swelling (belly), nausea and/or vomiting, having light-coloured stools or darker than normal urine, losing weight, tiredness (fatigue), swelling in the arms, legs, etc. Certain bone diseases may also be indicated by elevated ALP levels. Joint and/or bone pain or enlarged and/or irregularly shaped bones are a few of the symptoms of bone disorders.

Thus, to keep your health in check, you can get the Alkaline Phosphatase, Serum test performed at Hindustan Wellness for a price that is significantly less than the going rate in the market. Our skilled phlebotomists carry out each test precisely. Furthermore, the technicians have a lot of experience performing complex tests.
packages.why_test:
Some of the crucial functions of this test are listed below:
Comprehensive metabolic panels (CMPs) and liver panels frequently include ALP tests. 
Healthcare professionals frequently use these panels as part of a standard check-up to screen for a variety of potential health issues.
Your doctor may request an ALP test if you have a liver, bone, or other condition. This is frequently done as part of a panel to determine whether your condition is getting better, getting worse, or staying the same with or without treatment.
ALP levels can play a significant role in the diagnostic process even though they cannot be used to diagnose a condition. The type or severity of a condition may be indicated by the degree to which the ALP level is elevated or decreased in comparison to normal.

packages.title: Aldosterone/Renin ratio Aldosterone/PRA ratio
packages.description: An aldosterone/renin ratio (ARR) is a screening test to detect primary aldosteronism.a calculation is done by dividing the aldosterone result by the renin result.
packages.what_test:
Aldosterone is delivered by the adrenal organs situated at the highest point of the kidney, in their external part (called the adrenal cortex). Aldosterone stimulates the maintenance of sodium (salt) and the disposal of potassium by the kidneys. Renin is delivered by the kidneys and controls the enactment of the hormone angiotensin, which stimulates the adrenal organs to release aldosterone.

Various circumstances can lead to overproduction of aldosterone(hyperaldosteronism, generally called aldosteronism) or underproduction (hypoaldosteronism). packages.description: Adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) is a hormone that stimulates the production of cortisol. Cortisol is a steroid hormone made by the adrenal glands that is important for regulating glucose, protein, and lipid metabolism, suppressing the immune system’s response, and helping to maintain blood pressure.
packages.what_test:
At the base of your brain, there lies a pea-sized gland called the pituitary. It generates a variety of hormones, including adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH). The adrenal glands release two hormones- cortisol and adrenaline- above the kidneys when ACTH activates them (also known as epinephrine). These hormones strengthen your immune system and enable you to react to stress in a healthy way.

The steroid hormone cortisol has an impact on a variety of bodily systems, including your: cardiovascular system, system of defence, neural system, bone synthesis, and metabolism of food components such as protein, lipids, and carbs. If your doctor suspects your adrenal glands aren't working properly, they may ask you to take an ACTH (cosyntropin) test. 

Through Hindustan Wellness, a trustworthy site you get can afford this test at honest rates. Before taking the test you must receive an injection of cosyntropin, a synthetic form of ACTH, in order to complete this test. Additionally, two blood samples will be taken from you: one before and one after the injection. These samples evaluate how much cortisol is present in your blood.
packages.why_test:
The adrenal glands' response to the ACTH in your blood is determined by this ACTH stimulation test. It achieves this by checking the cortisol levels in your body. It's critical to distinguish this test from an ACTH test, which gauges your blood's ACTH levels.
Addison's illness (adrenal insufficiency) diagnosis is made with the ACTH stimulation test. It is also used to establish whether hypopituitarism is the cause of poor pituitary function. Alternately, secondary adrenal insufficiency could result from a cortisol deficiency.

packages.title: ASO QUALITATIVE
packages.description: Antistreptolysin O (ASO) titer is a blood test to measure antibodies against streptolysin O, a substance produced by group A streptococcus bacteria. Antibodies are proteins our bodies produce when they detect harmful substances, such as bacteria.
packages.what_test:
An ASO Qualitative test full form is antistreptolysin O titer. It is a test used for measuring antibodies produced in the human body after coming in contact with a toxin known as streptolysin O. Streptolysin O is created by group A streptolysin bacteria. Your body produces antistreptolysin O antibodies as a response to these toxin bacteria. 
Antibodies are those proteins that are created by your body in response to harmful bacteria. 
An ASO test is performed to check whether the patient is suffering from any health disease caused by any recent strep infection. 

At Hindustan Wellness, you can book ASO Qualitative tests with simple steps. We offer a variety of tests at a very affordable price. We have an experienced panel of phlebotomists. Our technicians and staff are well trained in carrying out any test efficiently. You can book all your tests at Hindustan Wellness from our website
packages.why_test:
An ASO Qualitative test is required in certain medical conditions. ASO qualitative test is a blood sample test that is used to check the condition of infection caused by group A streptococcus. 
However, if there are symptoms if they show up then you can have an ASO Qualitative test. 
Infections
Due to lack of proper treatment, strep bacteria can harm other body parts as well. The spread of these bacteria can cause infection in the skin and ear. 
Fever in children
 From the age of 5to15 years, most children suffer from scarlet fever. It is a harmful fever for children if not treated on time. 
Rheumatic fever
This fever is not a contagious one rather it depends on the reaction of the immune system after a strep fever infection. Some of the common symptoms of rheumatic fever are breathing problems, chest pain, jerking etc.
Other symptoms 
It can cause kidney disease as well which can lead to kidney failure such as Glomerulonephritis. You may witness blood in your urine, tiredness, breathing problems and throat pain.
packages.how_test: To book an ASO Qualitative Test at Hindustan Wellness, you have to follow some easy steps. Visit our website and select the 'book now' option. Select ASO Qualitative test and enter your contact number. You will receive an OTP on your contact number. After filling OTP your slot for ASO Qualitative test will be booked.
preparation_instructions: For the ASO qualitative test, blood samples of the patient are required for further testing. There are a few points you can keep in mind while going for this test.
Do not consume anything at least 6 hours before your ASO Qualitative test. This 6-7 hours of fasting is mandatory and this will help in carrying out accurate results.

faqs.question: What are the symptoms of scarlet fever?
faqs.answer: Ans. There are many symptoms such as fever, red rashes all over your skin, throat soreness, pain while swallowing and swollen tonsils. Scarlet fever is common among children from the age of 5 to 15. This is considered to be a harmful illness. So if any of these symptoms show up immediately contact your doctor and get an ASO Qualitative test.

faqs.question: Why do I need to get the ASO test again even after getting negative the first time?
faqs.answer: Ans. Your doctor may advise you to take the ASO Qualitative test twice or thrice even after being negative because sometimes the first test shows negative while the second one gives a slightly positive result. Just to be sure your doctor may prescribe this test more than twice a week.

faqs.question: What are the things I should avoid one day before the ASO test?
faqs.answer: Ans. Do not eat anything at least 6 hours before your ASO Qualitative test. It would be great if you do not consume any type of alcohol or smoke cigarettes. It is a blood sample test so you need not do a lot of things before the ASO test.

faqs.question: What is the treatment for ASO?
faqs.answer: Ans. Therapies like antiplatelet and drugs like vasodilatory are useful in treating ASO. There are some other important things you must do such as not smoking cigarettes. If you have some other disease then control them with diet and exercise. Fever and cold can be treated with medications.

packages.title: Karyotyping by G-Banding Reflex
packages.description: Karyotyping refers to an analysis of these 46 chromosomes in their condensed states during metaphase, and their G-banding patterns, to detect losses and gains of entire chromosomes, large deletions or duplications (also known as 'copy number variations' or CNVs), as well as inversions and rearrangements.
packages.what_test:
A karyotype test is performed to check the size, number and structure of your chromosome. A chromosome contains genes which you inherit from your father and mother. Normal people have 46 chromosomes. All chromosomes are divided into 23 pairs. Every pair contains 2 chromosomes of your mother and father respectively. Karyotyping is used to check whether these chromosomes are normal or unusual. 
In cytogenetics, G-banding is used to identify karyotypes by contaminating condensed chromosomes. It helps in determining genetic diseases with the help of pictorial presentation of the chromosome complement.

If you are pregnant and you think you have any risk factor that may harm your baby then you can have to karyotype by G-banding test. This test will reveal any type of abnormalities in the genes of an unborn child. This test can reveal some major diseases such as, down syndrome and Edwards syndrome 

At Hindustan Wellness you can book Karyotyping by G-Banding reflex test done by following simple steps. We offer a variety of tests at a very affordable price. We have expert phlebotomists that help in carrying out all the tests. We also have experienced technicians. For more details, you can visit our website.
packages.why_test:
There are plenty of reasons behind the Karyotyping G-Banding test. Some of them are listed below.
For checking if the unborn child is suffering from any type of genetic abnormalities
For diagnosing any type of genetic disorder in infants and children 
To check any type of chromosomal defect that leads to the death of the unborn child ( stillborn).
To find out any type of chromosomal abnormality that is deterring women from getting pregnant. 
To check any type of genetic abnormality so that you can be prepared before planning a baby. 
If you are diagnosed with cancer or blood disorder then you can take this test to plan your treatment. 
You can take this test if you have any family history or genetic disorders.
packages.how_test: To book Karyotyping by G-Banding test at Hindustan Wellness, you can visit our website. Choose the 'book now option and then fill in your contact number. After that, you will receive an OTP as a confirmation. After filling OTP you will successfully register for Karyotyping by G-Banding test. Only these simple steps are required for booking any test at Hindustan Wellness. If you want, you can also book this test at home. A representative of the company would come to your house to collect the samples and you will get the reports via mail.
preparation_instructions: There are some basic guidelines that you must follow prior to the Karyotyping by G-Branding Reflex Test.
You do not have to prepare a lot of things before going for Karyotyping by G-Banding reflex test.
Do not get hyper and avoid stress
Book your Karyotyping by G-Banding test at least one day before

faqs.question: What is G-Banding?
faqs.answer:
G-Banding is a technique that allows chromosomes to get identified by their pattern. The pattern of banding can easily show the abnormalities such as deletions and insertions. 
Structural imbalance of chromosomes can also be identified.

faqs.question: Why is Karyotyping often required for unborn children?
faqs.answer: Ans. Karyotyping is often required for unborn children to check whether the baby is suffering from any genetic abnormalities.

faqs.question: What abnormalities can be detected through Karyotyping?
faqs.answer: Ans. The Karyotyping test is useful in determining diseases like down syndrome, Turner syndrome and Edwards syndrome. It is also required for harmful diseases like cancer and blood infection.

faqs.question: Why are my karyotyping results getting delayed?
faqs.answer: Ans. Karyotyping results may take a longer time depending on the complex or abnormal karyotyping. However, the reports may take 1 to 2 weeks to come.

faqs.question: Why is karyotyping required after miscarriage?
faqs.answer: Ans. Karyotyping is required after miscarriage to look for any type of chromosomic abnormality. To perform karyotyping after miscarriage, cells from the tissue of miscarriage have to grow in the lab.

packages.title: PUS CULTURE
packages.description: This test is done on a pus sample to identify the presence of pathogenic organisms. The Pus culture and sensitivity technique is majorly used to confirm the aerobic bacteria's sensitivity, which infects the human body. Both males and females can take this test to confirm the infection.
packages.what_test:
Any growth or invasion of germs in a human body is known as infection. Infection is spread through various pathogens such as bacteria, yeast, virus, or fungi, causing symptoms like fever, chills, cough, stiffness in the body along with pain. Culture tests are normally conducted to identify bacterial or viral infections. In your body, whichever part there is a bacterial infection, causes the body to react. There is swelling and formation of a whitish-yellow, yellow or brown protein-rich fluid known as pus. Doctors prescribe a Pus culture test to diagnose bacterial infection and treat them. 

A swab of pus is collected as a sample and is analysed. Pus is normally formed at the site of an infection or the place where a wound has been developed or where the person was hurt. All the ways indicate the damage due to foreign objects’ invasion into your body. In case the wound is deeper, a syringe may be used to extract the fluid from the body.

Hindustan Wellness is a healthcare facility that conducts this test. It is a reputed healthcare facility that promotes overall health care and assistance in the diagnosis and treatment of illnesses.
packages.why_test:
A Pus culture test is needed for the following reasons:
Initially, when the body is attacked by some bacterial infection, it sticks to a particular part. However, when the infection grows, it contaminates the blood. This test helps in diagnosing such health issues.
This test helps the doctor identify the nature of an infection. It provides information such as in the infection if viral or bacterial, etc. 
It is important to test for Pus culture as it helps figure out what kind of infection has attacked your body. Proper treatment can be provided only when the infection has been properly identified.

faqs.question: What triggers hypertension, anyway?
faqs.answer: The exact reason why some individuals acquire hypertension and others don't is unknown, but we do know that lifestyle factors including lack of exercise, unhealthy eating habits, being overweight, becoming older, and heredity all play a role.

faqs.question: How Can I Tell If My Blood Pressure Is High?
faqs.answer: In most cases, you won't even be aware that you suffer from high blood pressure since there are no noticeable signs. Due to this, hypertension is often identified during a preventative health exam with a medical provider.

faqs.question: If I have hypertension, what kind of food should I be on?
faqs.answer: High blood pressure may be helped by following a healthy diet like the DASH (Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension) diet. According to the DASH eating plan, you need to eat a particular amount of fruits, veggies, and whole grains every day.

faqs.question: Which lab tests should be performed to diagnose hypertension?

Insulin PP (postprandial) is a test that is conducted to measure the amount of insulin in the blood. Insulin is a type of hormone that is useful to move the blood sugar, known as glucose, from blood streams into the cells. This glucose comes into the body from food and drinks and it is the main source of energy. 

The insulin hormone plays a very important role in maintaining the right level of glucose in our bodies. If its level goes too high or too low, then it would create serious health problems.

faqs.question: What are the symptoms of insulin resistance?
faqs.answer:
Insulin resistance shows no symptoms in its early stage. When it reaches the secondary stage, then our body starts to show some problems. These could be:
Lethargy
Difficulty concentration
High cholesterol level
High blood pressure
Hunger
Weight gain

faqs.question: What are hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia?
faqs.answer:
Hyperglycemia: it is a condition when the blood sugar level in our body gets too high. This increase in the blood sugar level occurs when our body does not make enough insulin. If there is no insulin in our body, then the glucose won’t get into the cell and will stay in the bloodstream instead. Hyperglycemia is the reason for type 1 diabetes.

Hypoglycemia: it is a condition when the blood sugar level in our body gets too low. If our body is sending too much insulin in our blood, then too much glucose will go into our cells and then this leaves less glucose in the bloodstream. Hypoglycemia is the reason for type 2 diabetes.

packages.title: TSH
packages.description: The TSH test measures thyroid-stimulating hormone, which is a hormone that prompts the thyroid to produce other hormones.
packages.what_test:
Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH) test is a blood test that measures the hormone secreted from the thyroid. Thyroid is a gland located in the front of the neck with the function of controlling the metabolism of your body. It helps in the transformation of food into energy that the body requires to function. It stimulates a hormone that is being released into the bloodstream and produced in the brain. It works constantly to monitor the level of thyroid hormones. In case it detects the level of hormone is lesser than the normal range, it releases TSH.

There are two types of diseases associated with TSH. In case there is an elevated TSH level, there is a thyroid hormone deficiency found in the body. This condition is known as Hypothyroidism. Similarly, when there is a deficiency in the TSH level, high amounts of thyroid hormones are found in the blood. This is known as hyperthyroidism. 

Hindustan Wellness, a top diagnostic firm in India, is available for such tests. It provides its services all over India with the added advantage of getting tested at one’s own residence. It assures accuracy of test reports and better diagnosis of a disease with the help of the World Class Lab and USA-FDA approved fully automated equipment, with the most advanced testing instruments operated by the team of highly experienced and qualified doctors and technologists to provide the best cost-efficient tests to its customers.
packages.why_test:
The reasons for the TSH test are as follows:
In case the symptoms are seen related to thyroid, a test can be suggested by the doctor.
The TSH test helps ascertain the health condition and diagnose the disease so that it can be treated on time.
There are two thyroid-related conditions. The test helps figure out if it is hypothyroidism or hypo hypothyroidism. 
The thyroid-related hormones regulate the functions of the body. It is important to know the correct level of the hormones to assess the function of the body. 
Thyroid is a health condition which is mostly associated with unhealthy lifestyles and diets. With the help of the TSH test, a person can make sure that he/she has better health-related activities in the future to avoid such conditions. 
Extremely low levels of thyroid hormones can cause a serious health issue called myxedema which can be life-threatening. A person can lose consciousness and even go into a coma. A TSH test prevents such conditions by monitoring the health situation and taking precautionary measures as well as medications.
packages.how_test:
TSH Test Procedure (How it works)
The test can be booked in easy steps either using the website of Hindustan Wellness or the application of the organisation or through its helpline numbers where assistance is provided to book the test. Through the website or the application, one can select the test and confirm it by adding it to the cart, just like the shopping sites, and making the payment at the checkout point. If you opt for the application for booking the test, you get the facilities like booking the test with ease, getting and viewing your test reports on the application itself, getting added discounts, getting scheduled medicine-related reminders and viewing the diet plan that's best for you.
preparation_instructions: For the TSH test, blood samples are collected. In order to be prepared for the test, one needs to be aware of and follow the given instructions:
You need to fast for 12 hours before the test.
You have to avoid all kinds of drinks except water 12 hours before the test.

faqs.answer: The symptoms of hypothyroidism are fatigue, sensitivity to cold, constipation, weight gain, and pain and weakness of muscles. The symptoms of hyperthyroidism are sudden weight loss, rapid heartbeat, anxiety, nervousness and increased appetite.

packages.title: Thyroid Panel 2, Free
packages.description: This test measures the amount of FT4 and FT3 in your blood. T4 & FT3 is one of two major hormones produced by the thyroid gland
packages.recommended_for: People with symptoms such as Changes in Sensitivity to temperature, Memory problems,Weight changes,Mood changes
packages.what_test:
Thyroid panel 2, free test is required to diagnose the state of thyroid in a person. There are two states, i.e. underactive-thyroid (hypothyroid) and overactive-thyroid (hyperthyroid). This test makes a detailed analysis of your thyroid hormones and tries to identify any thyroid disorder. 

The thyroid is a small gland that is located in front of the neck, wrapped around the trachea. The shape of the thyroid resembles a butterfly as it is small in the middle and has two wings on each side that extends around the side of your throat. It produces hormones that play a major role in many different systems throughout the body. Health concerns could arise if it produces too much or too little hormones. 

At Hindustan Wellness, you can get yourself tested to check your thyroid hormone level and find a treatment for it. The organisation offers many benefits to its customers such as a complete hygienic facility, accurate reports with the help of its advanced technology, an offer to conduct the test at the customer’s preferred location, and a diligent team to take care of all your diagnosis related requirements.
packages.why_test:
There are certain symptoms to understand both the thyroid states. A test and diagnosis are required to understand them both.
In case of hyperthyroid, more hormones are generated by the gland and the body uses the energy too quickly. It makes the body tired and heart beat faster and even causes anxiety and nervousness. If such symptoms are detected, a doctor can be consulted and a Thyroid Panel 2, Free Test can be conducted to confirm the state and start the treatment. 
If not detected and treated on time, the thyroid hormone disorder can cause autoimmune disorders making it at risk for other diseases.
packages.how_test: To ascertain the condition and hormone level, select the test from the website of Hindustan Wellness and add it to your cart, similarly to online shopping. After checking out and confirming the test through payment for it, you can book a test for yourself. Hindustan Wellness may ask for your preferred location to conduct the test and act accordingly.
preparation_instructions: You are not required to fast for this test. However, you have to avoid certain foods that are rich in biotin such as organ meats, fish, eggs, seeds, nuts, and certain vegetables such as sweet potatoes.

Drinks like black coffee, tea, and other caffeinated beverages are diuretics, which have a dehydrating effect on the body. It may result in inaccurate reports if consumed before the test. Therefore such drinks must be avoided before the test.
Your physician may instruct you to keep your bladder empty before conducting the test.
Consumption of nicotine and alcohol are also prohibited 48 hours before the blood test as they are agents of blood thinner and are injurious to health.

faqs.question: What are the impacts of abnormal thyroid hormone in the body?
faqs.answer: It could cause heart problems like rapid heart rate and risk of heart stroke, problems related to bones, eye problems, red and swollen skin, and thyrotoxic crisis

faqs.question: What are the treatments for thyroid diseases?
faqs.answer: Once a person is contracted thyroid-related diseases, a person has to be careful throughout their lifetime. The treatments include antithyroid drugs, radioactive iodine, beta blockers and surgery if needed.

faqs.answer: Hindustan Wellness offers a variety of thyroid-related tests that can be conducted at home. There are certain methods that can be followed to check the thyroid, however, the results are not accurate and may cause panic amongst people.

With the help of the thyroid hormone, the body uses the energy in order for the brains, heart and muscles to function properly. 

Vitamins are the micronutrients in the body that provide the energy for the body to function properly. Deficiency in vitamins could impair the body from functioning causing tiredness, weight loss, loss of energy, fatigue, etc. 

Thyroid and Vitamin combo test is a great opportunity to assess the information related to overall health and diagnose disease, if any and treat them in time. packages.why_test:
Both thyroid and Vitamins are vital to your body. It makes the body function properly. Damage to any one of them could make it difficult for your body to perform the simplest tasks. It is important to keep a check on them through this test.
This combo test could be conducted as a part of routine checkup. It is better to be aware of one’s health than to regret later.
Your physician may suggest any one of the two tests or both if any imbalance is suspected. 
Vitamins play a very important role in the functioning of the thyroid gland. Deficiency in vitamins in your body could indicate problems related to thyroid.
Therefore, diagnosing one problem could indicate problems with other organs. 
Moreover, getting both the tests together is more cost effective than conducting them separately.

packages.description:
What is Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) HBV-DNA quantitative test (Serum Or plasma)?
Patients' blood viral loads can be measured before, during, and after antiviral medication trials using quantitative detection of hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA in serum or plasma. In either acute or chronic hepatitis B, the amount of HBV DNA decreases to undetectable levels, which is a positive prognostic indicator. Additionally, the presence of HBV DNA enables the estimation of a person's propensity for infection as either a hepatitis B patient or an HBV carrier. For the early detection of newly infected blood donors and for the detection of HBV in therapeutic plasma protein preparations, a highly sensitive method of HBV DNA detection is useful. Hindustan Wellness provides Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) HBV-DNA quantitative Viral load Serum Or plasma test at a significantly lesser price as compared to other laboratories in India. packages.title: Sphingomyelin-IgM Phospholipid
packages.description: The anti-phospholipid antibody (APLA) syndrome (APS) is a condition characterized by various clinical manifestations in combination with the presence of APLAs.
packages.what_test:
Sphingolipids are the types of phospholipids that have a long chain amino acid alcohol called sphingosine attached to the fatty chain acid attached to it. Phospholipids are a group of lipids that contain fatty acids, phosphoric acids, nitrogen bases, and alcohol. They are an important part of the cell membrane and play a major role in the functioning of the body. Phospholipids prevent the accumulation of fats in the liver. Its main job is to protect the cells of our body from harmful substances. 

Our body creates antibodies when it finds any harmful and infectious agents that might instigate an illness inside our body. However, antiphospholipids are the antibodies that mistake some of our cells to be harmful, create a defence against them or harm them. Thus, creating a negative effect on our bodies. 

Sphingomyelin-IgM Phospholipid Test checks for the antiphospholipids antibodies in the blood and diagnoses any diseases related to heart, lungs, kidneys or livers. Hindustan Wellness provides this test facility to its customers at a discounted price than the market. It is an accredited organisation with advanced technology and facility for its customers to get the test done at their preferred location.
packages.why_test:

It checks for any sign of concern that may affect the vital organs of our bodies.

Major diseases and risks like tuberculosis (TB) and heart failure can be prevented if the antibodies are traced on time.
A person might go through vision problems, speech and memory problems, headaches, extreme tiredness, difficulty in maintaining body balance and repeated miscarriages in females are the symptoms of antiphospholipid antibodies. These symptoms can be used to recognise the sign of alarm and consult a physician for treatment.

You are allowed to drink water, but nothing other than that 10-12 hours before the test.

packages.title: Serotonin 5-Hydroxy Tryptamine, Serum
packages.description: Serotonin 5-Hydroxy Tryptamine, Urine test is done To help diagnose a carcinoid tumor that produces serotonin
packages.what_test:
This test determines the level of 5-Hydroxy Tryptamine in the urine. The liver breaks down the serotonin into 5-Hydroxy Tryptamine acid. Serotonin is a neurotransmitter responsible for carrying messages between nerve cells in the brain and body. It affects a person’s mood, sleep, nausea, wound healing, digestion, and sexual desires. If the serotonin levels fall in the body the person may become depressed and anxious.

Serotonin is mainly found in the intestines. About 90% is present in the cells which form the lining of the gastrointestinal tract. The remaining 10% is produced by the brain. Serotonin is made by the amino acids present in the food we eat. One should undergo a serotonin test if they show symptoms of carcinoid tumour which may occur in the lungs, intestinal tract, or appendix. The symptoms consist of diarrhoea, vomiting, low blood pressure, sudden weight loss, etc.

Hindustan Wellness is a leading healthcare company that provides this test at economical prices which are lower than the rates offered in the diagnostic centres. The organisation is well-versed and promises to offer its services all over the nation.
packages.why_test:
Increased serotonin levels in the blood determine the chances of carcinoid tumours in parts like the intestinal tract, lungs, appendix, or some body tissues.
If you experience symptoms like face flushing, abdominal cramps, diarrhoea, vomiting, nausea, low blood pressure, sudden weight loss, irregular heartbeats, asthma, watery eyes, etc.
If the person experiences anxiety, depression, mania, or mood swings then you should get a serotonin test done.
Higher levels of serotonin usually mean carcinoid tumours, cystic fibrosis, non-carcinoid tumours, and malabsorption. Symptoms may include sweating, restlessness, confusion, shivering high blood pressure.
Lower levels may cause migraines, depression, mood swings, and anxiety.
Serotonin helps the brain control your sleep cycle. People with varying serotonin levels may show signs of too much or too less sleep.
The density of your bones also depends on the serotonin levels. Higher serotonin levels may lead to bone fracture and breaking the bones.
This test may also tell if the body isn’t producing enough serotonin or is unable to use the serotonin produced.

After the registration process, they reach you instantly.
preparation_instructions: It is mandatory to fast for 12 hours prior to the test.
It is advisable to take the test in the morning before taking your daily medications if any.
In the case of menstruating ladies, they must inform it beforehand to their health provider to avoid any false reports due to the presence of blood traces in the sample.
The patient is advised to collect the urine in a cup and submit it to the health provider. They must not drink lots of water for frequent urination because it might dilute the urine.

faqs.question: How to get rid of rotavirus antigen quickly?

faqs.question: Is rotavirus antigen contagious?

faqs.question: Can rotavirus affect my baby even if my baby is vaccinated?
faqs.answer: Yes, children may get affected even after being vaccinated against rotavirus antigen. However, it is an uncommon phenomenon. If your child gets a rotavirus infection after getting vaccinated, then the infection will have a mild effect on your child's health.

packages.description: PTH controls blood levels of calcium, phosphorus, and vitamin D. The parathyroid glands produce more PTH when calcium levels in the body are low. packages.what_test:

In our body, if the calcium levels are low, the glands in the neck release PTH to bring the calcium levels back to normal. Once the calcium level is normal, the glands stop releasing it.

PTH is one of the most important regulators of calcium and phosphorus in the body. It has many unique functions in the body that a test might be required to prevent any abnormal PTH level. An abnormal PTH level might lead to lower or higher levels of calcium, phosphorus, and vitamin D in your blood. 

A body might go through some changes such as a leaner or thicker body, indicating hyperthyroidism or hypothyroidism. Diagnosis and treatment are important to avoid such conditions. packages.description: Proteins, Serum is a total serum protein test measures the total amount of protein in the blood. Too much protein in your blood can be a sign of chronic infection or inflammation (like HIV/AIDS or viral hepatitis). It can also be an early sign of a bone marrow disorder.
packages.what_test:
A total serum protein test calculates the blood's overall protein content. Additionally, it calculates the levels of albumin and globulin, two significant protein subgroups, in the blood.

Albumin.

This is primarily produced in the liver. It aids in preventing blood vessels from spilling blood. Albumin is necessary for the growth and healing of tissues as well as for the transportation of various medications and other substances via the blood.

Globulin.
These are composed of various proteins of the alpha, beta, and gamma kinds. The immune system produces some globulins, while the liver produces others. Haemoglobin can bind to specific globulins. Other globulins aid in the fight against infection and carry metals like iron in the blood. Serum protein electrophoresis allows the division of serum globulin into various subgroups.

Total protein, albumin, and globulin readings are reported separately by a test for total serum protein. It is also possible to measure some globulin subtypes, including alpha-1 globulin.

packages.description: Hemoglobin A2 may be increased in beta thalassemia or in people who are heterozygous for the beta thalassemia gene and its level tends to increase in conditions that delay nuclear maturation of red cell precursors.
packages.what_test:
HbA2 Haemoglobin A2 Test is used to check the HbA2 levels in people with beta-thalassemia.

Beta thalassemia is a genetic disorder that occurs due to a deficiency in the production of the beta globin chains of haemoglobin. It is the oxygen-carrying protein in red blood cells. Normally haemoglobin is made up of four globin chains, each bound to a heme group. These are alpha, beta, gamma, and delta. The four globin chains combine in different ways to give rise to different kinds of haemoglobin. 

First, there’s haemoglobin F or HbF, where F stands for fetal haemoglobin, and it’s made up of two alpha-globin and two gamma-globin chains. Hemoglobin A or HbA, the major adult haemoglobin form is made up of two alpha and two gamma-globin chains. Finally, haemoglobin A2 or HbA2 accounts for a small fraction of adult haemoglobin in the blood, and it’s made up of two alpha-globin and two gamma-globin chains. With beta-thalassemia, there’s either a partial or complete beta-globin chain deficiency. It is caused due to point mutation.

A C-reactive protein (CRP) test with high sensitivity (hs-CRP) is more sensitive than a regular CRP test. That is, the high-sensitivity test can detect modest increases in CRP levels that are within the normal range. The hs-CRP test can be used to estimate your risk of developing coronary artery disease, a condition in which your heart's arteries narrow. A heart attack can be caused by coronary artery disease.

A high blood level of Hs-CRP has been related to an increased risk of a heart attack. Furthermore, those with a high Hs-CRP level who have had a heart attack are more likely to have another one than those with a normal Hs-CRP level.

A Hs-CRP test is not appropriate for everyone. The test does not reveal the cause of inflammation — and a high level may indicate that the inflammation isn't hurting your heart, especially if it's considerably higher than normal.

A Hs-CRP test may be most beneficial for persons who have a 10% to 20% chance of having a heart attack in the next ten years, or who are at intermediate risk. packages.what_test:
The complex protein known as HB, or haemoglobin, is found in human red blood cells and carries iron molecules. It mainly transports oxygen from the lungs of a human being to the body's tissues, where it exchanges with carbon dioxide before returning to the lungs to exchange for oxygen. 

Additionally, haemoglobin is an iron-containing protein that is often found in red blood cells. It enables Red Blood Cells to absorb oxygen in the lungs and transport it to many other organs and tissues throughout the human body.

Two alpha and two beta globin chains are present in the typical adult Hb molecule. But, Beta chains are absent in fetuses and newborns, because their molecule is composed of two alpha chains and two gamma chains instead. The adult haemoglobin structure results from the gradual replacement of the gamma chains by beta chains as the newborn matures.

The level of Hb in your blood is determined via a Hemoglobin (Hb) test. packages.description: The fructosamine test for diabetes is a blood test that measures average blood glucose levels over the two or three weeks prior to when the test is performed.
packages.what_test:
The fructosamine test is used to determine how effectively your diabetes is controlled by assessing your blood glucose levels. Measuring your blood glucose levels is an essential element of treating diabetes and preventing the health concerns that this condition can cause.

When a form of blood sugar called glucose mixes with other molecules known as proteins, a chemical known as fructosamine is produced. A blood sample taken from a vein is necessary for fructosamine testing.

The fructosamine test analyses the quantity of glucose bound to proteins in serum or plasma, both of which are derived from the fluid component of blood.

The more glucose there is in the blood, the more it will bind to proteins. The main component of the fructosamine assessment is albumin, which is the most prevalent protein in the blood. Proteins stay in the blood for 14 to 21 days on average, hence the fructosamine test provides average glucose reading over the past 2 to 3 weeks.

packages.recommended_for: to diagnose fever dengue virus infection
packages.what_test:
The Dengue profile (Dengue-IgG, IgM, NS1, Platelet count) aids in the identification of the Dengue virus. The virus dengue is spread by mosquitoes in tropical areas. The second-most serious tropical illness, after malaria, is dengue fever. 

In India, the dengue virus exists in all four serotypes. Infections without symptoms occur significantly more frequently than infections with symptoms. Dengue infection with one serotype does not provide cross-protection against another. If it is infected again, it could result in dangerous disease types including dengue hemorrhagic fever and dengue shock syndrome. Given this, it becomes crucial to identify primary from secondary dengue early in the course of infection.

Dengue NS1 Antigen develops prior to the onset of fever and symptoms and peaks 2-3 days after the onset of disease. By the third day following the infection, a primary dengue infection produces measurable levels of IgM antibodies, which typically last for 2–6 months. Dengue IgG antibodies develop later than IgM, roughly on day 7 of the fever, during the main infection and last longer, sometimes for years. packages.what_test:
Blood cultures continue to be the gold standard for bacteremia diagnosis. Traditionally, two bottles are usually collected: an aerobic bottle, which allows for the preferential development of aerobic and facultative anaerobic microorganisms, and an anaerobic bottle, which allows for the preferential growth of strictly anaerobic bacteria. packages.description: The creatinine clearance test checks your kidney function by looking at the amount of creatinine in your urine and blood.
packages.what_test:
The creatinine clearance test is an old method of assessing kidney function. This test allows you to examine urine and blood samples to determine how much of the waste product — creatinine — is filtered out by your kidneys. Abnormal creatinine levels in your urine and blood may indicate a kidney problem.

The creatinine clearance test is performed in two parts: collecting your urine over a 24-hour period of time and then drawing your blood. These samples are then analysed to determine how much creatinine was filtered through your kidneys in a 24-hour period. The test results will be used in a mathematical formula to calculate your creatinine clearance.

These dangers may include age (you could be at a higher risk after age 60), diabetes, blood pressure is high (hypertension), kidney disease that runs in the family, and heritage.

Diagnosing Myasthenia gravis (MG) in people with symptoms of chronic muscle weakness and fatigue.
Checking for the condition if the muscle weakness spreads to other parts of the body. 
The MuSK Antibody checks for the acetylcholine receptor antibodies.
We need this test to distinguish Myasthenia gravis from other disorders which have similar symptoms like MG.
To check and monitor the respiratory myasthenic crisis.
To analyse the type of autoantibodies present inside the body as it has a huge impact on the MG.

preparation_instructions: To avoid any error or inaccuracy in your MuSK test reports, follow the sets of instructions mindfully mentioned-below.
Do not eat anything or drink tea or coffee before your sample is collected. However, drinking water is permitted.
Please make sure you have discussed all your past medical history with your doctor before proceeding with the test.
Avoid taking any medicines prior to the test as they may interfere with the test reports.
Consumption of alcohol, tobacco, and nicotine is prohibited at least 24 hours before sample collection.

faqs.question: What does the MuSK antibody test indicate?
faqs.answer: The MuSK Antibody Muscle Specific Kinase Ab Test helps diagnose the Myasthenia gravis; it is a condition caused by the breakdown of communication between muscles and nerves.
